# C2Pro CI/CD

This file used to describe the pre-2026-07 workflow set (tests.yml, e2e-security-tests.yml,
frontend-ci.yml, frontend-e2e.yml, deploy-production.yml), all of which were consolidated
or retired in the CI/CD overhaul.

**The canonical, maintained documentation lives at
[`docs/runbooks/ci-cd-setup.md`](../docs/runbooks/ci-cd-setup.md)** — pipeline overview,
trigger matrix, required secrets, environments, branch protection, release process, and the
recipe for adding CI to new apps/services.
